help.title: Help
help.description: Quick answers about Oriole and its integrations.
help.needMoreDesc: Full architecture & deployment docs live in this repo. Start with docs/architecture.md.
help.faq1q: How do I create a booking?
help.faq1a: Open the Bookings menu and click “New booking”. The form covers schedule, customer, and AI call options — this feature is live after the bootstrap phase.
help.faq2a: Auth is handled by Neon Auth (managed Better Auth). Sessions are JWTs verified by the backend via remote JWKS — no passwords are stored in this app.
help.faq3a: AI agents place outbound calls to customers for booking confirmations/reminders automatically. Inbound call handling isn't supported yet — call results come back via authenticated webhooks, recorded with idempotency, then queued for processing.
help.faq4a: Paddle acts as the Merchant of Record. Subscription status is synced via HMAC-verified webhooks to an Inngest function.
help.faq5q: When will production feature pages ship?
help.faq5a: This app shell is the foundation. Production dashboard, booking, billing, and analytics are being built on the connected plumbing (DB, auth, billing, jobs, email).

landing.heroHeadline: Automate Your Booking. Delight Your Customers.
landing.heroSubheadline: An AI-powered booking assistant that helps businesses manage bookings, answer customer questions, and handle reservations automatically — 24/7.
landing.integrationDesc: Meet customers where they already are, keep your schedule in sync, and turn every conversation into a completed booking.
landing.integrationFootnote: From WhatsApp and Telegram conversations to forms, calendars, payments, and webhooks — Oriole keeps the whole booking journey moving.

landing.painTitle: Your customers are ready to book. Are you ready to answer?
landing.painDesc: Every missed message can become a lost customer. Businesses spend hours answering repetitive questions, managing schedules, and confirming bookings manually.
landing.painSupportDesc: Your team spends hours answering the same questions repeatedly instead of solving real problems.
landing.painAnswersDesc: Documentation is scattered, outdated, or hard to search, leaving customers frustrated.
landing.painResponseDesc: Without self-serve options, customers wait for human support when they need answers now.
landing.painVisibilityDesc: You don't know which articles are missing or which ones fail to answer customer questions.
landing.painMissedDesc: Customers expect instant replies. Slow responses lead them elsewhere.
landing.painSchedulingDesc: Managing bookings through chats and spreadsheets creates unnecessary work.
landing.painRepeatDesc: Your team answers the same questions every day.

phoneNumber.cancelSetupDesc: This releases the number that was being set up. Nothing is charged and you can connect again anytime.
phoneNumber.cancelSetupFailed: Couldn't cancel the setup. Try again.

phoneNumber.methodByoDesc: Use a number from your existing provider.
phoneNumber.vapiCountryHint: Vapi numbers are available for US national use. For international numbers, bring your own.

phoneNumber.byoEmpty: No numbers found for this country.

phoneNumber.manageCallingHint: Outbound calls are always on. Inbound calling will be available soon.
phoneNumber.healthUnavailable: Health data isn't available right now.
